moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.original: The organizations are not available to you.
The organizations you administer have more than ${count} user accounts, and the access log is not narrowed to that many: it is read by an administrator of every organization
moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.localized: 您管理的组织有超过 ${count} 个用户账号，访问日志不会缩小到这个数量：由管理所有组织的管理员读取

moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.original: The parent changes from the date given; the earlier parent is kept as history. Both must be organizations you administer; empty makes it top level.
moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.localized: 上级组织自所给日期起更改；原先的上级作为历史保留。两者都必须是您管理的组织；留空则使其成为顶级。

moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.original: The person gets a link that works once. They sign in with the account of that address, or create one, and get the organization and the access you choose. IronStone BOSS users is always included; privileged and sealed access is never offered.
moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.localized: 该人员收到一个只能使用一次的链接。使用该地址的账号登录，或创建一个，并获得您选择的组织和访问权限。始终包含 IronStone BOSS users；从不提供特权和密封访问。

moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.original: The primary address, phone and email. Bank accounts and payment instruments stay in Accounting.
moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.localized: 主要地址、电话和电子邮件。银行账户和支付工具仍在会计中。

moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.original: The reusable texts of the mail a person writes
moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.localized: 人员撰写邮件时的可复用文本

moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.original: The shared guidance every agent run gets, for the instance and each organization
moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.localized: 每次智能体运行都会获得的共享指南，适用于实例和每个组织

moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.original: The shared guidance for people and agent runs. An organization may have its own document, which replaces the instance's for its members; members read it in the Assist drawer under Constitution / Rules.
moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.localized: 面向人员和智能体运行的共享指南。组织可以有自己的文档，对其成员取代实例的文档；成员在助手抽屉的宪章 / 规则中阅读。

moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.original: The sites whose pages open inside the app as references are the instance's policy, set in System › Constitution › Origins by an instance administrator. An organization's document cannot add one; a reference to another site is refused on save.
moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.localized: 作为参考在应用内打开页面的站点是实例策略，由实例管理员在系统 › 宪章 › 来源中设置。组织的文档不能添加站点；保存时会拒绝指向其他站点的参考。

moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.original: The staff of the organizations you administer. An identity that also works elsewhere shows only your organizations; account-wide changes to it need identity-global authority.
moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.localized: 您所管理组织的员工。同时在别处任职的身份只显示您的组织；对其整账号的更改需要全局身份权限。

moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.original: These texts have no ${preview?.locale ?? locale} translation and come from another language:
moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.localized: 这些文本没有 ${preview?.locale ?? locale} 的翻译，来自另一种语言：

moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.original: This instance has no mail server, so the invitation was not emailed. Copy this link and pass it to ${revealed.emailAddress} yourself. It is shown only now: resend the invitation for a new one.
moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.localized: 此实例没有邮件服务器，因此邀请未通过电子邮件发送。请复制此链接并自行交给 ${revealed.emailAddress}。仅此次显示：重发邀请可获得新链接。

moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.original: This organization has its own Constitution, replacing the instance Constitution for its members.
moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.localized: 此组织有自己的宪章，对其成员取代实例宪章。

moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.original: This organization uses the instance Constitution.
This step does not move a resource
This step's owner is no longer registered to move it; ask its owner
moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.localized: 此步骤的所有者不再注册为可转移此项；请询问其所有者

moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.original: Trunks, numbers, ring groups, menus and queues: the phone system's own screens
moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.localized: 中继、号码、振铃组、菜单和队列：电话系统自己的界面

moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.original: Units, currencies, types and statuses are changed in the app that owns them, by whoever that app lets. A change there never rewrites a posted document.
moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.localized: 单位、货币、类型和状态在所属应用中更改，由该应用允许的人操作。那里的更改从不改写已过账的文档。
未知的 Admin 注册表操作 ${name}

moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.original: User ${id} has no party to assign work to
moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.localized: 用户 ${id} 没有可分配工作的参与方

moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.original: Users are not available to you.
What is failing, and who fixes it?
moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.localized: 什么出了故障，由谁修复？
什么会启动智能体运行

moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.original: What the display is, such as Plant floor wall
moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.localized: 此显示屏是什么，例如车间墙面

moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.original: What the people of the organizations you administer did
moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.localized: 您所管理的组织中的人员做了什么

moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.original: What this device shows of the route group: a wall display's playlist. The device cannot open another.
moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.localized: 此设备在路由组中显示的内容：墙面显示屏的播放列表。设备不能打开其他内容。

moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.original: Where the device is, such as Plant floor east wall
moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.localized: 设备所在位置，例如车间东墙

moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.original: Where the staff of your organizations are signed in. Signing a session out sends its next request to the sign-in page; an identity shared with another organization needs identity-global authority.
moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.localized: 您的组织的员工在何处处于登录状态。结束一个会话会使其下次请求进入登录页；与其他组织共享的身份需要全局身份权限。

moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.original: Why can't this user sign in? Check the account's state, sign-in lock, factor, allowed IPs and groups, and say who can fix it
moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.localized: 此用户为什么不能登录？请检查账号状态、登录锁定、因素、允许的 IP 和组，并说明谁可以修复
